title: A Calibrated Test of Internal Action Maps: State Signals Without Global Affine Closure
abstract: arXiv:2608.13626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A hidden state signal can be decodable or causally usable without supporting a reusable action map. We test whether action maps fitted without a source reach its natural post-action activation and compose. We organize the tests as an evidence lattice and validate the geometric branch on a known affine S_5 carrier: all held-source folds pass one-step, composition, inverse, decoding, and commutativity gates. Structured curvature and held-domain conjugacy raise error monotonically, but only 23/30 strongest cells flip a closure gate, bounding rather than universalizing calibration. In post-trained Qwen/Qwen3-4B, frozen final-token h28 affine maps have mean held-entity error .519, versus .398 for within-test-domain cross-fit. Seven randomized entity splits and map geometry do not support a purely entity-specific account. translated_title: 内部动作映射的校准测试：无全局仿射闭合的状态信号
translated_abstract: 隐藏状态信号可以被解码或在因果上使用，而无需支持可复用的动作映射。我们测试了在无源条件下拟合的动作映射是否能够达到其自然的动作后激活状态并进行组合。我们将测试组织为证据格，并在已知仿射S_5载体上验证几何分支：所有保留源折叠均通过一步、组合、逆、解码和交换性门。结构化曲率和保留域共轭会单调地增加误差，但只有30个最强单元中的23个翻转闭合门，从而限制了而非普遍化了校准。在训练后的Qwen/Qwen3-4B中，冻结的最终令牌h28仿射映射的平均保留实体误差为0.519，而测试域内交叉拟合为0.398。七个随机实体分割和映射几何不支持纯粹的实体特定解释。较早的h4/h16层能更好地拟合一步转换，但h4冲突状态解码较弱，词汇控制仍然存在。
tldr: 本文通过系统化的证据格测试表明，内部动作映射在无全局仿射闭合条件下仅部分可校准，且不同层级的映射能力存在显著差异，挑战了通用动作映射假设。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically tests internal action maps via an evidence lattice, showing only partial calibration without global affine closure and significant layer-wise differences, challenging universal action map assumptions.
